heading: Tonight
text: Partly clear. passing clouds north, and high clouds in southeast NH and MA spreading into southern valleys. Lows in the 30s to near 40. Winds shifting to the north, mostly less than 10 mph, but gusting to 15 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tuesday
text: Sun, mixed with a few clouds north, and some high clouds through southeast NH, giving way to increasing afternoon sunshine. Highs in the 50s north, upper 50s to low 60s south. Winds light, mostly north to northeast, increasing to 10 to 15 mph through the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys, gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: Mostly clear and cold. Lows in the upper 20s and 30s. Winds diminishing to light and variable, expect north winds persisting near Lake Champlain 10 to 15 mph.
